map.估算填埋场有机垃圾的甲烷产量与当量。: Estimate the methane production and its equivalent from organic waste in a landfill.
map.CH₄ = 有机物 × 可降解比 × MCF × 体积比 × 16/12: CH₄ = organic matter × degradable fraction × MCF × volume fraction × 16/12
map.收集的甲烷可用于发电，减少排放。: Collected methane can be used for power generation, reducing emissions.
map.沼气潜力：录入填埋量与可降解比例，估年甲烷产量。: Biogas potential: enter the landfilled volume and degradable fraction to estimate annual methane production.
map.减排核算：对比收集焚烧 vs 无控排放，量化 GWP 收益。: Reduction accounting: compare collection and flaring with uncontrolled release to quantify the GWP benefit.
map.教学演示：演示甲烷 GWP 远高于 CO2。: Teaching demo: show that the GWP of methane is far higher than that of CO₂.
map.示例：年填埋 1 万 t、可降解有机 40%、产率 0.05 m³CH₄/t，年: Example: 10000 t landfilled per year with 40% degradable organic content and a yield of 0.05 m³CH₄/t gives about 2 million m³ of methane per year (to be corrected by the model).
map.甲烷产率怎么定？: How is the methane yield determined?
map.由有机质组成与降解模型（如 IPCC）给出，受温度湿度影响，以方法学为准。结果按: It is given by the organic composition and a degradation model (such as IPCC) and is affected by temperature and moisture; the methodology governs. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.甲烷 GWP 高（百年约 28–34 倍 CO2），收集利用可大幅减排并产能源。: Methane has a high GWP (about 28–34 times CO₂ over 100 years), so collecting and using it cuts emissions sharply and produces energy. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.开放填埋甲烷直排温室效应强，是环卫领域重点减排源。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算，: Methane released directly from open landfills has a strong greenhouse effect and is a priority reduction source in the sanitation field. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.垃圾填埋甲烷排放（IPCC 一阶近似口径）：CH₄ = 有机物量×DOC×MCF: Landfill methane emissions (IPCC first-order approximation): CH₄ = organic matter × DOC × MCF × CH₄ volume ratio × 16 ÷ 12 (kg/year; 16÷12 is the molecular-weight ratio for carbon to methane); linked value: CO₂ equivalent = CH₄ × 28 (kgCO₂e, GWP-100 = 28). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the higher the degradable carbon fraction DOC and the methane correction factor MCF, the higher the emissions; the result keeps one decimal.
